approaches.title: Direct brute-force rotation evaluation
approaches.summary: Computes each rotation independently with nested loops, summing the weighted elements for every possible starting position. This is marked wrong due to time-limit failure.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented direct nested-loop evaluation of every rotation. Marked wrong for timing out.

approaches.title: Rotation recurrence
approaches.summary: Uses the relationship between consecutive rotation sums to update each value in constant time after computing the initial sum. This reduces the algorithm to O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
